detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

LC 216 (Lipo-B formulation)

Chemical Information: (Formulated Compound)

LC216 is a formulated aqueous research compound composed of amino acids, vitamins, and related biochemical cofactors. The designation “LC216” refers to the total combined mass (216 mg) of active compounds contained within the formulation.

Formulation Components:
  • L-Carnitine — 20 mg
    Molecular Formula: C7H15NO3
    Molecular Weight: 161.20 g/mol
  • L-Arginine — 20 mg
    Molecular Formula: C6H14N4O2
    Molecular Weight: 174.20 g/mol
  • Methionine — 25 mg
    Molecular Formula: C5H11NO2S
    Molecular Weight: 149.21 g/mol
  • Inositol — 50 mg
    Molecular Formula: C6H12O6
    Molecular Weight: 180.16 g/mol
  • Choline — 50 mg
    Molecular Formula: C5H14NO
    Molecular Weight: 104.17 g/mol
  • Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine) — 25 mg
    Molecular Formula: C8H11NO3
    Molecular Weight: 169.18 g/mol
  • Vitamin B5 (Dexpanthenol) — 25 mg
    Molecular Formula: C9H19NO4
    Molecular Weight: 205.25 g/mol
  • Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin) — 1 mg
    Molecular Formula: C63H91CoN13O14P
    Molecular Weight: 1344.40 g/mol
Product Description:

LC216 is a multi-component liquid research formulation designed for laboratory studies involving amino acids and vitamin-based cofactors. Each compound is included at a defined concentration to support controlled research into formulation behavior, compound compatibility, and biochemical interaction in vitro. LC216 is supplied as an aqueous solution for ease of handling and experimental consistency. This product is not intended for injection, parenteral administration, or any human or veterinary use.

Research Applications:
  • In vitro evaluation of amino acid and vitamin cofactor systems
  • Study of multi-compound formulation stability
  • Investigation of biochemical interactions in controlled laboratory models
  • Analytical research involving nutrient-related compounds
Storage and Handling:
  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended before and/or after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised.
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Maintain aseptic handling procedures
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Total Compound Content: 216 mg per bottle
  • Composition:
  • L-Carnitine: 20 mg
  • L-Arginine: 20 mg
  • Methionine: 25 mg
  • Inositol: 50 mg
  • Choline: 50 mg
  • B6 (Pyridoxine): 25 mg
  • B5 (Dexpanthenol): 25 mg
  • B12 (Methylcobalamin): 1 mg
  • Volume: 10 mL
  • Appearance: Pink to violet colored (tinted) liquid
  • Analytical Testing: Component-verified
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Certificate of Analysis (COA): Available via QR code or COA-archive
Compliance Notice:

LC216 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
